risk_notes: Sandbox is empty; department must be created before assignment if it does not exist.

payload.headline: Near-perfect employee onboarding; one check failed, 5 errors hurt efficiency
what_went_wrong: Check 5 failed — likely the employment form or remuneration type mapping; 'PERMANENT' + 'MONTHLY_WAGE' may not match expected values for the scoring check.
Initial POST /employee with userType=STANDARD caused a 422 validation error (email required); should default to NO_ACCESS when no email is available.
Two unknown endpoint attempts (POST /employee/employment/employmentDetails and POST /employee/employment/workingHours) wasted calls and added errors before finding correct paths.
departmentNumber='1' was hardcoded arbitrarily; this could conflict with existing departments or scoring expectations.
what_worked: Core onboarding flow completed: department, employee, employment, details, and standardTime all created successfully.
Correctly identified /employee/employment/details and /employee/standardTime endpoints after initial failures.
what_to_try_next: Inspect /employee/employment/details schema before posting to verify correct employmentForm and remunerationType values — the failed check likely relates to one of these fields.
Remove the initial POST /employee with userType=STANDARD; go directly to NO_ACCESS when no email is in the offer letter to eliminate the 422 error.
Eliminate speculative endpoint guesses (employmentDetails, workingHours) by using inspect_tripletex_endpoint or search_tripletex_api BEFORE making API calls to unknown paths.
unnecessary_calls: POST /employee with userType=STANDARD — caused 422, should have used NO_ACCESS directly
